Sabai destination illustrations

The SVG illustrations in this directory were created for this project by Codex.
They are original stylized illustrations, not location photographs or maps.
No external photo assets are incorporated.

Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Destination coordinates and geographic country outlines have separate sources
recorded in the destination metadata and project documentation.
